def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_list = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_list)

    feature_names = [
        'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
        'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
        'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
        'avg_review_score_last90', 'n_reviews_last90',
        'n_orders_last_30', 'n_orders_last_60', 'n_orders_last_90',
        'n_orders_last_180', 'n_orders_last_365',
        'trend_30_90', 'delivered_share', 'avg_delivery_days',
        'n_canceled', 'n_canceled_last90', 'cancel_rate',
        'avg_installments', 'credit_share', 'avg_payment_value',
        'recency_ratio', 'orders_per_active_day'
    ]
    for f in feature_names:
        features[f] = 0.0

    order_items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_list)) & (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask].copy()

    # заказы, о существовании которых уже известно к seed_time
    known_orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]
    known_order_ids = set(known_orders['order_id'])
    items = items[items['order_id'].isin(known_order_ids)]

    if not items.empty:
        agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('price', 'size'),
            total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            first_purchase=('ts', 'min'),
            last_purchase=('ts', 'max')
        )
        agg['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days.astype(float)
        agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_purchase']).dt.days.astype(float)
        agg['lifetime_days'] = (agg['last_purchase'] - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days.astype(float)
        agg['has_sales'] = 1.0
        agg['recency_ratio'] = agg['days_since_last'] / (agg['days_since_first'] + 1.0)
        agg['orders_per_active_day'] = agg['n_orders'] / (agg['lifetime_days'] + 1.0)

        base_cols = ['n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
                     'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
                     'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
                     'recency_ratio', 'orders_per_active_day']
        for col in base_cols:
            features.loc[agg.index, col] = agg[col].values

        # ---- скользящие окна по продажам ----
        for period in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            period_items = items[items['ts'] >= cutoff]
            if not period_items.empty:
                cnt = period_items.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
                features.loc[cnt.index, f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = cnt
        t90 = features['n_orders_last_90']
        t30 = features['n_orders_last_30']
        features['trend_30_90'] = (t30 * 3.0 - t90) / (t90 + 1.0)

        # ---- отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ----
        rev_known = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
        rev_known = rev_known[['order_id', 'review_score']].drop_duplicates('order_id')
        uoi = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(
            rev_known, on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
        if not uoi.empty:
            ra = uoi.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
            features.loc[ra.index, 'avg_review_score'] = ra['mean']
            features.loc[ra.index, 'std_review_score'] = ra['std'].fillna(0.0)
            features.loc[ra.index, 'n_reviews'] = ra['count']
            cutoff90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
            rev90 = uoi.merge(
                rev_known, on='order_id', how='left', suffixes=('', '_k')
            )
            # даты создания отзывов
            rev_dates = rev_known.set_index('order_id')['review_creation_date']
            uoi2 = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
            uoi2['rev_date'] = uoi2['order_id'].map(rev_dates)
            uoi2 = uoi2.dropna(subset=['rev_date'])
            uoi90 = uoi2[uoi2['rev_date'] >= cutoff90]
            if not uoi90.empty:
                ra90 = uoi90.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
                features.loc[ra90.index, 'avg_review_score_last90'] = ra90['mean']
                features.loc[ra90.index, 'n_reviews_last90'] = ra90['count']

        # ---- статусы/доставка: только известные к seed_time заказы ----
        ord_info = known_orders[['order_id', 'order_status',
                                 'order_delivered_customer_date']].copy()
        oi = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(
            ord_info, on='order_id', how='left'
        )
        oi['delivered'] = ((oi['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) &
                           (oi['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)).astype(float)
        oi['canceled'] = (oi['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])).astype(float)
        g = oi.groupby('product_id').agg(
            delivered_share=('delivered', 'mean'),
            n_canceled=('canceled', 'sum'),
            n_all=('canceled', 'size')
        )
        g['cancel_rate'] = g['n_canceled'] / g['n_all']
        features.loc[g.index, 'delivered_share'] = g['delivered_share']
        features.loc[g.index, 'n_canceled'] = g['n_canceled']
        features.loc[g.index, 'cancel_rate'] = g['cancel_rate']

        dd = oi[oi['delivered'] == 1].copy()
        dd['delivery_days'] = (dd['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                               dd['order_id'].map(
                                   known_orders.set_index('order_id')['order_purchase_timestamp']
                               )).dt.days
        avg_dd = dd.groupby('product_id')['delivery_days'].mean()
        features.loc[avg_dd.index, 'avg_delivery_days'] = avg_dd.clip(lower=0)

        cutoff90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        cc = oi[(oi['canceled'] == 1) &
                (oi['order_id'].map(
                    known_orders.set_index('order_id')['order_purchase_timestamp']) >= cutoff90)]
        if not cc.empty:
            ncc = cc.groupby('product_id').size()
            features.loc[ncc.index, 'n_canceled_last90'] = ncc

        # ---- платежи: только по известным заказам ----
        pay_known = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(known_order_ids)]
        if not pay_known.empty:
            pay_prod = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(
                pay_known[['order_id', 'payment_installments', 'payment_type',
                           'payment_value']],
                on='order_id', how='inner'
            )
            if not pay_prod.empty:
                pg = pay_prod.groupby('product_id').agg(
                    avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
                    avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean')
                )
                features.loc[pg.index, 'avg_installments'] = pg['avg_installments']
                features.loc[pg.index, 'avg_payment_value'] = pg['avg_payment_value']
                ctype = (pay_prod['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(float)
                pay_prod['_cc'] = ctype
                cs = pay_prod.groupby('product_id')['_cc'].mean()
                features.loc[cs.index, 'credit_share'] = cs

    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_list)
    for col in features.columns:
        features[col] = pd.to_numeric(features[col], errors='coerce')
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    return features
